610:t_1:86.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Wherever the $$サイデリアル$$ advance, there is always battle... which is to say, death.」

610:t_1:87.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Guiding lost lives to the heavens is the duty of $$鬼宿$$... In that sense, this is a fitting place for us.」

610:t_1:88.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「And it doesn't bother you that most of your clan was wiped out...?」

610:t_1:89.en:
$$尸刻$$
「What about you, General $$サルディアス$$?」

610:t_1:90.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I hear you have belonged to the $$サイデリアル$$ far longer than we have, but I have never heard about your past.」

610:t_1:91.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, I wasn't scouted as a whole organization like you two. There's nothing worth telling.」

610:t_1:92.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「My homeworld was destroyed, I became one of the $$サイデリアル$$, and just when I thought I was leading a unit to seize the $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$, I'd somehow become that Reactor's deputy, yes.」

610:t_1:93.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「So you were a candidate for Reactor?」

610:t_1:94.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I'm embarrassed to say...」

610:t_1:95.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, at first I too had my star destroyed and lost my family and friends... Like $$バルビエル$$, I hated everything in the world.」

610:t_1:96.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「But you know... in the end, for the sake of saving my own skin, I threw that hatred away... So I can't laugh at $$ガドライト#pilot$$, can I?」

610:t_1:97.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$... I hear that man raised the banner of revolt against the $$サイデリアル$$.」

610:t_1:98.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, that's only natural, I suppose. Considering that man's circumstances.」

610:t_1:99.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Are you implying that we are the same?」

610:t_1:100.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「So you saw through my fishing...」

610:t_1:101.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well... even with discontent in our hearts, I suppose we have no choice but to make the best of our current positions.」

610:t_1:102.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Naturally. My battlefield is wherever Lady $$エルーナ$$ is.」

610:t_1:103.en:
$$尸刻$$
「As long as $$尸空#pilot$$ fulfills the mission of $$鬼宿$$, the whole clan and its retainers will do nothing but follow.」

610:t_1:104.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well then, now that your resolve is settled, let us defend the $$ラース・バビロン$$ defense line to the death.」

610:t_1:105.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Shall we not live up to the expectations of the commander who posted his three prized deputies here?」

610:t_1:106.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That was my intention from the start.」

610:t_1:107.en:
$$尸刻$$
「I will carry out the mission I have been given.」

610:t_1:108.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「We each have our own feelings about $c, after all. Let's make this a last stand with our backs to the wall.」

610:t_2:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But I was surprised. To think that Chief and $$トビー$$ were with Dr. $$トライア$$.」

610:t_2:5.en:
$$トビー$$
「The doctor saved our lives, you know. Playing bodyguard is kind of our way of saying thanks.」

610:t_2:7.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「$$トビー$$ and I aren't people of the $$ＵＣＷ$$ or the $$ＡＤＷ$$... We're more like foreign objects that $$アサキム$$ dragged here by force.」

610:t_2:8.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Maybe that's why, in the $$新世時空震動$$, we got thrown into some place like a rift between dimensions, along with the $$バルゴラ$$.」

610:t_2:9.en:
$$トビー$$
「And the doctor is the one who helped us out of it.」

610:t_2:10.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm happy. To be able to meet you two again like this.」

610:t_2:11.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Looks like you kept the name of $$グローリー・スター$$ alive while we were gone.」

610:t_2:12.en:
$$トビー$$
「That's our ace for you! With this, looks like Chief's and my backup isn't needed anymore.」

610:t_2:14.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Every soldier has a position of their own. Protecting the $$ソーラリアン$$ is ours.」

610:t_2:15.en:
$$トビー$$
「I'm leaving the front line to you, $$セツコ$$. Go slam our $$ＧＳコンバット・アクション$$ into the $$サイデリアル$$!」

610:t_2:17.en:
$$ランド$$
「Still, who'd have thought Sis was that $$クロノ$$'s $$クィーン$$.」

610:t_2:18.en:
$$メール$$
「So she's still putting on airs like a queen, as always!」

610:t_2:19.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「You can say that, but it was $$クロノ$$ that gave me this code name.」

610:t_2:20.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「If you had become a member of $$クロノ$$, I'm sure you'd have gotten a lovely code too.」

610:t_2:25.en:
$$メール$$
「I can't let it go as a joke!」

610:t_2:26.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Sorry, $$メール$$. ...But have you grown up a little since I last saw you?」

610:t_2:28.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Sorry, but I'm a little tired... Could you make me some coffee?」

610:t_2:30.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「You're as straightforward as ever.」

610:t_2:32.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Watching her reminds me of a past I can't go back to...」

610:t_2:34.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「No need to worry about me. I'm living with my past shaken off, too.」

610:t_2:35.en:
$$ランド$$
「What about having been in $$クロノ$$?」

610:t_2:36.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「I knew of its existence since I was in the $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

610:t_2:37.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Though in that world, with $$ロゴス$$ and the $$ティターンズ$$ out in front, its existence was completely concealed.」

610:t_2:38.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'd have thought 《$$ジ・エーデル#keyword$$》 would gladly smash a sneaky, stuck-up organization like that...」

610:t_2:39.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「He turned a blind eye to $$クロノ$$.」

610:t_2:41.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Do you think I could understand what that man is thinking?」

610:t_2:42.en:
$$ランド$$
「Good point. Nobody can keep up with his off-the-wall thinking.」

610:t_2:43.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「But this world's $$クロノ$$, built on the organizations of the $$ＵＣＷ$$ and the $$ＡＤＷ$$, took me in after the $$新世時空震動$$ transferred me here.」

610:t_2:44.en:
$$ランド$$
「Because Sis is a so-called $$特異点$$?」

610:t_2:45.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Exactly. ...After the $$時の牢獄$$ was destroyed, I thought I'd be handed over to the $$サイデリアル$$, but...」

610:t_2:46.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「$$キング$$ let me escape.」

610:t_2:47.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$キング$$ is the head of $$クロノ$$, right? So why...?」

610:t_2:48.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Looking back now, it seems $$キング$$ had his own thoughts about the $$サイデリアル$$.」

610:t_2:49.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「That said, he couldn't take any concrete action; he seems to have been just an old man who watched events from the sidelines.」

610:t_2:50.en:
$$ランド$$
「So Sis backed us in fighting the $$サイデリアル$$ to protect herself, too...」

610:t_2:53.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「I found I wanted to believe, too. In the light in people's hearts that I saw in that $$多元戦争$$.」

610:t_2:56.en:
$$ランド$$
「He got taken down by $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. Not that it'd kill him, though.」

610:t_2:58.en:
$$ランド$$
「Could it be that you're the one who freed him from the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ on Mars...?」

610:t_2:59.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ have $$スフィア・リアクター$$s too... I thought that if it could work as a check on them even a little... but...」
